title: Additive add-attendees receipt preserving current skipped strings
description: Proposed successful receipt extension over cd089433. Invalid batches remain errors with diagnostics and no partial writes; this schema alone cannot prove persisted outcomes or input attribution.

added.description: Preserved addresses actually added. A repeated input address can also occur in skipped; do not treat these arrays as disjoint sets.

skipped.description: Preserve the existing canonical address-string array and its semantics; never replace these values with detail objects.

email_sent.description: Preserved server-reported flag, not proof of delivery.

skipped_details.description: Additive per-input explanation. Invalid input details belong to an atomic error response, not a partially successful invalid batch.

email.description: Canonical address when valid, or bounded sanitized caller-provided value in invalid-input error diagnostics.

input_index.description: Zero-based original raw email-list occurrence, before normalization or deduplication.

basis.description: Distinguishes an earlier duplicate occurrence from an address present before the call; unknown storage races must not be mislabeled as known complete outcomes.
